notes.Food > Vegetables > Tomatoes: Includes cherry, roma, beefsteak, and all tomato varieties - group here by grocery-store convention even though botanically a fruit.
notes.Food > Vegetables > Cucumbers, Squash &: Includes cucumbers, zucchini, pumpkin, eggplant/aubergine - also botanically fruits, group here anyway.
notes.Food > Vegetables > Herbs & Aromatics: Fresh herbs (basil, chives, parsley, dill, cilantro, mint) and fresh ginger. Dried herbs and ground spices go under Pantry > Spices.
notes.Food > Vegetables > Cabbage & Brassicas: Broccoli, cauliflower, Brussels sprouts, all cabbages (red, white, Chinese, savoy), kohlrabi. Not carbonated drinks (Kohlensaeure).
notes.Food > Fruits > Tropical & Stone Fruit: Avocado, kiwi, mango, pineapple, peach, nectarine, plum, apricot, cherry.
notes.Food > Fruits > Grapes: Fresh table grapes (Trauben). Grape juice goes under Beverages > Juice.
notes.Food > Dairy & Eggs > Cream Cheese: Frischkaese, Philadelphia and similar spreadable cream cheese - not hard/sliced Cheese and not Pantry > Spreads.
notes.Food > Dairy & Eggs > Yogurt, Skyr & Qua: Includes yogurt, skyr, quark/Speisequark, and similar cultured dairy products. Quark and Skyr are NOT cheese.
notes.Food > Meat & Fish > Ham & Cured Meat: Schinken, Rohschinken, Kochschinken, Serrano/Prosciutto, Speck, Bacon-style cured pork. Sliced sausage cold cuts stay under Cold Cuts.
notes.Food > Pantry > Cereals & Muesli: Oats (Haferflocken), muesli, granola, cornflakes and other breakfast cereals - Pantry, never Vegetables.
notes.Food > Pantry > Legumes: Dry or canned lentils, chickpeas, beans (kidney, white, black). Lentil/bean ready-made stews (Eintopf) are Ready Meals; fresh green beans are Vegetables.
notes.Food > Pantry > Canned Goods: Canned vegetables, tinned fish, canned fruit. Canned or dried lentils, chickpeas and beans go under Legumes instead.
notes.Food > Pantry > Baking & Sugar: Flour, sugar, baking powder, yeast, vanilla, icing. Baking paper is a household item, not a food.
notes.Food > Pantry > Spreads: Includes jam, honey, Nutella, peanut butter, chocolate spread, marmalade - anything spread on bread. Cream cheese goes under Dairy & Eggs > Cream Cheese.
notes.Food > Pantry > Pasta & Rice: Includes fresh/refrigerated pasta too (Spaetzle, Tortellini, etc.), not just dry pasta.
notes.Food > Snacks & Sweets > Nuts, Seeds & D: Includes nuts (walnuts, hazelnuts, almonds), seeds (chia, flax, sunflower, pumpkin), and dried fruit.
notes.Food > Frozen & Ready Meals > Frozen Piz: Includes all frozen or chilled ready-to-bake pizza - not Bakery, even though it has bread-like dough.
notes.Food > Frozen & Ready Meals > Frozen Fru: All frozen vegetables, vegetable mixes (Pfannengemuese) and frozen fruit/berries.
notes.Food > Beverages > Beer: Includes all beer, including alcohol-free (alkoholfrei) beer - group by product type, not alcohol content.
notes.Food > Beverages > Wine: Wine of all colours, sparkling wine and sekt. Not Schweinefleisch (pork) or wine vinegar.
notes.Food > Beverages > Spirits: Vodka, gin, whisky, rum, liqueurs and other hard liquor.
notes.Household > Household Goods > Foils, Bak: Aluminium foil, cling film, bio-waste bags, bin bags (Muellbeutel) and baking paper (Backpapier). Baking paper is NOT kitchen roll.
notes.Household > Household Goods > Household: Batteries, button cells (Knopfzellen), and general household odds and ends (glassware, tools, bags).
notes.Other > Deposits & Refunds > Pfand: The deposit CHARGED when buying a bottle/container - item name is usually just 'Pfand', always a positive amount. Never merge into the drink it belongs to.
notes.Other > Deposits & Refunds > Returns & R: Empty bottles/containers being RETURNED for a refund - item name is usually 'Leergut', always negative or a refund. This is the opposite direction of Pfand, not the same thing.
notes.Other > Pharmacy > First Aid & Plasters: Plasters, blister plasters, bandages and wound care.
notes.Other > Pharmacy > Supplements: Vitamins, minerals, magnesium and other dietary supplements.
notes.Other > Not a product > Receipt text: Receipt artifacts that are not purchases: Summe, Zwischensumme, Posten, Gesamt, bare amounts like '42,54 EUR'.
notes.Personal Care > Cosmetics > Skincare: Includes body lotion, face cream, and moisturizers - even ones used in the bathroom/shower. Sun protection products go under Sun Care.
notes.Personal Care > Cosmetics > Sun Care: Sunscreen, sun milk/lotion (Sonnenmilch, LSF/SPF) and after-sun products (e.g. Sundance) - not Pharmacy, not Skincare.
notes.Personal Care > Hygiene > Shower & Bath: Only soap, shower gel, and bath/wash products. Lotions and creams go under Cosmetics > Skincare instead.
notes.Other > Miscellaneous > General: Use only when genuinely unsure - flagged for manual review, not a dumping ground.
